portabilityFix.symptom: Keycloak did not become ready on Ubuntu; local Docker Desktop passed.
portabilityFix.rootCause: The realm bind mount was 0600 owned by native Linux runner uid 1001, while Keycloak runs as uid 1000. Docker Desktop maps the bind owner and hid the unreadable mount.
portabilityFix.reproduction: A synthetic native-Linux file in a network-disabled disposable container was unreadable at uid 1000 with uid 1001 ownership and 0600, then readable at 0644.
portabilityFix.fix: Only the read-only mounted synthetic realm file is 0644 inside a private host directory kept 0700; unmounted admin/user secrets remain 0600. A nonroot read preflight fails immediately without printing credentials.

cleanBuildFix.symptom: Four native parity tests failed with FileNotFoundError on clean Ubuntu runner.
cleanBuildFix.rootCause: scripts/check.sh built units and CLI but omitted the four case/projection/receipt/evidence probe targets; previously generated local binaries hid the missing dependency.
cleanBuildFix.fix: Build all four probe targets explicitly before the Python parity tests.

ci.countingRule: Counts are per invocation and overlap across groups. The fast job explicitly skips its optional native test; the native job separately builds and runs that parity check without a skip. All seven required jobs actually succeeded.
